use_when: Use type progress at the top of a flow with three to five steps, such as booking: Dates and guests, Your details, Extras, Payment, Confirm.
Use type quantity to set a small number with − and +, such as Adults, Children and Rooms in the guests picker and filters.
Use state at-min when the value is at its lowest (0 children, 1 adult) and at-max at its highest, so the button can't go further.

dont_use_when.when: For a flow of one or two steps: a page title is enough.
For a number that can be large or exact, such as a price: use a text field.
To show how far something has loaded: use Progressbar.

variant_intent.progress: the steps of a flow such as booking, 3 to 5 steps
variant_intent.quantity: a − value + counter with a Label

a11y.fact: type quantity is a role="group" named by the label, with native <button> controls for − and +.
The − and + buttons have their own accessible names ("Decrease <label>", "Increase <label>") because their icons are decorative.
state at-min and at-max set the real disabled attribute on the − or + button, so it can't be focused or activated.
The counter value is an <output> with aria-live="polite", so a change is announced.
type progress is an ordered list, and the current step carries aria-current="step".
Connector lines and step circles are decorative (aria-hidden); the step label carries the name.
A done step is a native <button> only when onStepClick is passed; otherwise it is plain text. Both buttons show the focus-border ring on :focus-visible.
